title: Stripe squeezy news carousel
description: Two-line heading with square lavender arrows over a 'squeezy' carousel: one wide picture card with big white words, then cards narrowing into thin slivers. Opening a card widens it smoothly; a two-tone caption and an outline button sit underneath.
notes: React state picks the open card: needs hydration; widths animate with CSS flex-grow (off under reduced motion)
phones show the open card and one sliver; tap the sliver to advance
